label: Übergeordnetes Optimierungsziel (optional)
help: Optional. Bleibt dieses Feld leer, leitet die App den Änderungsauftrag direkt aus den ausgewählten Einzelparametern ab.

options.label: Kein übergeordnetes Ziel · nur gewählte Merkmale ändern
Tätigkeit klarer erkennbar machen
options.value: Make the concrete workplace task immediately clearer and more understandable for the target audience.

options.label: Praxislernen und Verantwortung stärken
options.value: Strengthen the visual evidence of practical learning, early responsibility, and professional development.

options.label: Zusammenarbeit oder Anleitung hervorheben
options.value: Make collaboration, mentoring, or team support more credible and central to the campaign message.

options.label: Authentischer statt gestellt wirken
options.value: Reduce the staged stock-photo impression and make the scene feel more authentic and observational.

options.label: Zielgruppenansprache verbessern
options.value: Make the scene more relevant and approachable for school graduates and prospective dual-study applicants.

options.label: Kampagnenkomposition optimieren
options.value: Improve the composition for campaign use by strengthening visual hierarchy and usable negative space.

options.label: Kontrollierte A/B-Variante erzeugen
options.value: Create a controlled alternative for an A/B comparison while preserving the original campaign message.

label: Änderungsstärke
help: Eine geringe Änderungsstärke reduziert unnötige Abweichungen vom Ausgangsbild.

options.label: Gezielt und minimal (empfohlen)
options.value: Apply a targeted minimal edit. Preserve the source image as closely as possible outside the explicitly requested change.

options.label: Klar sichtbar, aber kontrolliert
options.value: Make the requested improvement clearly visible while keeping the main person, campaign message, and unaffected image elements stable.

options.label: Deutlich alternative Inszenierung
options.value: Create a noticeably different campaign interpretation while preserving the fictional main person's visual identity and the core employer-branding message.

label: Was besonders erhalten bleiben soll
help: Legt fest, welche Kontinuität beim Übergang von Stufe 1 zu Stufe 2 Vorrang hat.

options.label: Person, Grundszene und Kampagnenbotschaft
options.value: Preserve the fictional main person's visual identity, the core workplace context, and the central campaign message.

options.label: Person und Arbeitsumgebung
options.value: Preserve the fictional main person's visual identity and the existing workplace environment; change only the selected activity, interaction, or body language.

options.label: Person und Tätigkeit
options.value: Preserve the fictional main person's visual identity and the existing workplace activity; change only the selected composition, expression, gaze, or visual effect.

options.label: Vor allem die fiktive Person
options.value: Preserve the fictional main person's visual identity and natural proportions; the workplace environment may change only where explicitly requested.

label: Tätigkeit / Arbeitssituation
help: Nur ändern, wenn die Tätigkeit im Ausgangsbild unklar oder für die Kampagnenaussage ungeeignet ist.

options.label: Bestehende Tätigkeit deutlicher zeigen
options.value: Keep the existing type of workplace activity, but make the relevant hands, work objects, tools, documents, products, or screens clearer and causally aligned with the task.

options.label: Filiale: konkrete Aufgabe
options.value: Show a clear food-retail task such as checking a product display, coordinating shelf organization, reviewing availability on a tablet, or briefly discussing the work area.

options.label: Logistik: Warenfluss prüfen
options.value: Show a clear logistics task involving a handheld scanner, packages, organized storage zones, a delivery list, or coordination of a visible goods-flow process.

options.label: Verwaltung / Digitalprojekt
options.value: Show a clear administrative or digital project task involving a laptop, simple dashboard, notes, project documents, or a concrete planning and checking process.

options.label: Duales Studium: Praxislernen
options.value: Show a credible dual-study learning moment in which academic understanding is applied to a visible workplace task and growing responsibility becomes observable.

options.label: Ergebnis prüfen oder übergeben
options.value: Show the main person checking, explaining, presenting, or handing over a visible work result that is understandable without generated text.

label: Personenzahl und Interaktion
help: Zusätzliche Personen erhalten eine erkennbare Funktion in derselben Arbeitssituation und dienen nicht als bloße Dekoration.

options.label: Eine Person bei klarer Tätigkeit
options.value: Keep one clearly adult fictional main person as the only visible subject, focused on one concrete workplace task.

options.label: Austausch mit einer Person
options.value: Add or retain one clearly adult fictional colleague. Both adults share attention to the same document, screen, product, tool, package, plan, or work object, while the original fictional main person remains visually primary.

options.label: Anleitung / Mentoring
options.value: Show a credible learning interaction between the clearly adult fictional main person and one clearly adult fictional colleague: one adult explains or demonstrates a concrete work step while both attend to the same object or process.

options.label: Kleines Team bei gemeinsamer Aufgabe
options.value: Show a small fictional team of three clearly adult people collaborating as equals around one clearly visible workplace task. The original fictional main person remains recognizable and visually important.

options.label: Feedback oder Ergebnisübergabe
options.value: Show the clearly adult fictional main person and one clearly adult fictional colleague jointly checking, discussing, or handing over a visible work result. Their gaze and gestures must align naturally with the same result.

label: Pose / Körperhandlung
help: Die Pose sollte die Tätigkeit unterstützen und nicht wie ein losgelöstes Bewerbungsfoto wirken.

options.label: Aktiv bei der Tätigkeit
options.value: Place the main person in an active, anatomically plausible body position directly connected to the selected workplace task.

options.label: Natürlich stehend
options.value: Show the main person standing naturally with balanced weight, relaxed shoulders, and hands meaningfully connected to the work situation.

options.label: Sitzend am Arbeitsplatz
options.value: Show the main person sitting upright at a workstation with natural posture and hands positioned plausibly near the visible task.

options.label: In Bewegung
options.value: Show the main person walking or moving naturally through the workplace while remaining clearly connected to the depicted activity.

options.label: Zeigend oder erklärend
options.value: Show the main person using one natural explanatory gesture toward the shared document, screen, product, plan, tool, or work result.

label: Blickführung
help: Aufgabenbezogene Blickführung wirkt meist authentischer; direkter Kamerablick eignet sich für eine bewusste Ansprache.

options.label: Blick auf die Tätigkeit
options.value: Direct the main person's gaze naturally toward the document, screen, product, tool, package, plan, or work object used in the task.

options.label: Blick zur anderen Person
options.value: Direct the main person's gaze naturally toward the colleague involved in the same task or conversation.

options.label: Blick in die Kamera
options.value: Use natural direct eye contact with the camera while keeping the workplace activity credible and visible.

options.label: Leicht seitlicher Blick
options.value: Use a natural slightly off-camera gaze with a relaxed head position and clear facial detail.

label: Gesichtsausdruck / Ausstrahlung
help: Glaubwürdige, zurückhaltende Ausdrücke vermeiden übertriebene Werbeästhetik.

options.label: Konzentriert
options.value: Use a focused expression directed toward the visible task, with relaxed facial muscles and no theatrical intensity.

options.label: Ruhig selbstsicher
options.value: Use a calm, confident expression with steady eyes, a relaxed mouth, and credible professional presence.

options.label: Leicht natürlich lächelnd
options.value: Use a slight natural smile with relaxed eyes and cheeks, avoiding exaggerated enthusiasm.

options.label: Motiviert und aufmerksam
options.value: Use an alert and engaged expression with natural positive energy and credible facial detail.

options.label: Offen und ansprechbar
options.value: Use an open, approachable expression with authentic warmth and restrained campaign aesthetics.

label: Kleidung / Rollenwirkung
help: Nur anpassen, wenn Kleidung und dargestellte Tätigkeit nicht zusammenpassen.

options.label: Schlicht professionell
options.value: Use simple, well-fitted professional clothing without logos, slogans, name tags, or recognizable brand colors.

options.label: Moderner Arbeitslook
options.value: Use a clean modern work look with a plain shirt or overshirt, neat trousers, and practical understated shoes suitable for the visible task.

options.label: Business casual
options.value: Use restrained business-casual clothing with a plain shirt or blouse, neat trousers, and no visible branding.

options.label: Praktischer Filial- oder Logistiklook
options.value: Use clean practical work clothing appropriate for food retail or logistics, without company colors, logos, name tags, or readable markings.

options.label: Tech-casual
options.value: Use a plain sweater, shirt, overshirt, or casual jacket with neat trousers and no visible logos.

label: Bildausschnitt
help: Der Bildausschnitt wird unabhängig von der später nutzbaren Textfläche festgelegt.

options.label: Halbkörper mit sichtbarer Tätigkeit
options.value: Use a medium environmental shot that shows the main person from approximately head to waist together with enough workplace context to understand the task.

options.label: Dreiviertelkörper mit Arbeitskontext
options.value: Use a three-quarter body composition that keeps the main person recognizable while clearly showing relevant work objects and the surrounding workplace.

options.label: Weite glaubwürdige Arbeitsszene
options.value: Use a wide documentary composition in which people, workplace, and the concrete task remain immediately understandable.

options.label: Zentrierte Social-Media-Komposition
options.value: Use a balanced centered composition with a strong focal point, clear silhouette, and uncluttered background for social-media use within the existing aspect ratio.

label: Nutzbare Fläche für Kampagnentext
help: Reserviert eine klar abgegrenzte, ruhige Fläche. Die Hauptaktivität wird automatisch auf der gegenüberliegenden Bildseite angeordnet.

options.label: Rechts · etwa 35–40 %
options.value: Reserve approximately 35 to 40 percent of the image width on the right as calm, usable negative space for separately added campaign copy. Place the people, hands, workplace activity, and essential work objects clearly in the left portion of the frame.

options.label: Links · etwa 35–40 %
options.value: Reserve approximately 35 to 40 percent of the image width on the left as calm, usable negative space for separately added campaign copy. Place the people, hands, workplace activity, and essential work objects clearly in the right portion of the frame.

options.label: Oben · etwa 25–30 %
options.value: Reserve approximately 25 to 30 percent of the image height at the top as calm, usable negative space for separately added campaign copy. Keep faces, hands, workplace activity, and essential work objects clearly below this area.

options.label: Unten · etwa 25–30 %
options.value: Reserve approximately 25 to 30 percent of the image height at the bottom as calm, usable negative space for separately added campaign copy. Keep faces, hands, workplace activity, and essential work objects clearly above this area.

label: Gestaltung der reservierten Fläche
help: Wird nur angewendet, wenn eine Kampagnentextfläche ausgewählt ist.

options.label: Ruhig und szenenkonsistent (empfohlen)
options.value: Continue the existing workplace environment naturally into the reserved area while keeping it calm, uncluttered, low-detail, and visually subordinate.

options.label: Leicht unscharf und detailarm
options.value: Use a subtle, natural depth-of-field transition in the reserved area so it remains softly blurred, low-detail, and suitable for high-contrast campaign copy.

options.label: Hell und kontrastarm
options.value: Keep the reserved area naturally bright, low-contrast, and visually quiet without turning it into an artificial blank panel.

options.label: Dunkel und kontrastarm
options.value: Keep the reserved area naturally dark, low-contrast, and visually quiet without turning it into an artificial blank panel.

label: Bildwirkung
help: Die Bildwirkung sollte zur Zielgruppe und zur Aussage der Kampagnenvariante passen.

options.label: Authentisch und dokumentarisch
options.value: Use authentic documentary employer-branding photography with natural colors, credible workplace detail, and an observed rather than staged moment.

options.label: Warm und nahbar
options.value: Use warm, approachable employer-branding photography with natural human interaction, realistic skin tones, and restrained positive energy.

options.label: Professionell und verlässlich
options.value: Use professional, trustworthy campaign photography with balanced composition, realistic detail, and a calm visual hierarchy.

options.label: Modern und dynamisch
options.value: Use modern early-career campaign photography with credible movement, clear visual hierarchy, and no exaggerated advertising excitement.

options.label: Hell und zukunftsorientiert
options.value: Use bright, future-oriented campaign photography with realistic lighting, fresh but restrained colors, and a credible workplace atmosphere.

label: Gezielte Qualitätskorrektur
help: Dient der Korrektur eines konkreten Bildproblems; nicht mehrere unabhängige Korrekturen gleichzeitig erzwingen.

options.label: Hände und Arbeitsobjekt plausibilisieren
options.value: Correct hands, fingers, grip, and contact with the work object so that anatomy and task interaction are natural and physically plausible.

options.label: Hintergrund beruhigen
options.value: Simplify distracting background details while retaining the workplace cues needed to understand the task.

options.label: Körperproportionen korrigieren
options.value: Correct anatomy, body proportions, posture, and spatial relationships without changing the fictional main person's recognizable visual identity.

options.label: Licht und Hauttöne natürlicher machen
options.value: Correct lighting, shadows, color balance, and skin tones so that the scene appears natural and photographically coherent.

options.label: Artefakte und generierte Schrift entfernen
options.value: Remove visual artifacts, pseudo-text, accidental logos, unreadable signs, distorted objects, and other synthetic-looking details without changing the core scene.
